common.style_usage: Stardew Valley portrait style and FRAMING exactly like this portrait: large head filling most of the frame, shoulders cut off at the bottom; saturated hue-shifted cel shading, dark coloured (not black) outlines, about 30 colours
common.reference_usage: this exact character in this exact pose and framing: the same hair, glasses, charcoal coat, burgundy scarf, grey collar and head position; keep everything identical and change ONLY the facial expression

annoyed.description: Stardew Valley portrait of Julian Vane, a stern city art critic of about fifty: pale skin, swept-back dark hair with silver temples, narrow dark-rimmed glasses, charcoal coat, burgundy scarf. Same pose and framing as the reference, three-quarter view. Expression: cold irritation: eyes narrowed behind the glasses, a flat unamused mouth, the slightest downturn at the corners; a smooth forehead with no wrinkles, brows barely lowered

annoyed_b.description: Stardew Valley portrait of Julian Vane, a stern city art critic of about fifty: pale skin, swept-back dark hair with silver temples, narrow dark-rimmed glasses, charcoal coat, burgundy scarf. Same pose and framing as the reference, three-quarter view. Expression: curt displeasure: a sideways look of disdain, lips pressed together, a small sniff; calm smooth brow, no frown lines
